easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber. When it enters, Amulet of Vigor, Simic Growth Chamber and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Oracle of Mul Daya.
Because of the additional Oracle of Mul Daya token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

uses.name: Springheart Nantuko
uses.cardState: attached to Oracle of Mul Daya
